title: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
abstract: arXiv:2606.01950v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models enable intelligent agents to predict the consequences of their actions on the environment. In this paper, we propose Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM), a novel model that learns action-conditional dynamics of rigid objects in 3D. Using object-centric Gaussians, we can represent arbitrary object shapes and multi-object scenes. We develop a novel temporal-spatial transformer architecture that predicts future rigid body motion from a history of object Gaussians and future actions. Objects are represented by Gaussians in an object-centric frame, which allows to describe object motion as a rigid body transformation. Our model is trained on reconstructions from multiple viewpoints, which requires the model to also handle partial observations of objects due to occlusions. We analyze prediction performance of our approach on synthetic datasets composed of typical household objects with multi-object dynamics

translated_title: 学习面向刚体的动作条件化与以物体为中心的高斯泼溅世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够预测其动作对环境产生的后果。在本文中，我们提出了多刚体物体高斯世界模型，这是一种学习三维空间中刚体物体动作条件化动力学的新型模型。通过使用以物体为中心的高斯表示，我们能够表示任意物体形状以及多物体场景。我们开发了一种新颖的时空Transformer架构，可以从物体高斯的历史信息和未来动作预测未来的刚体运动。物体在以物体为中心的坐标系中用高斯表示，这使得物体运动可以被描述为刚体变换。我们的模型在多视角重建数据上进行训练，这要求模型还能处理因遮挡导致的物体部分观测问题。我们在由典型家居物体组成、具有多物体动力学的合成数据集上分析了我们方法的预测性能。
tldr: 提出MRO-GWM模型，利用以物体为中心的高斯表示和新颖的时空Transformer架构，学习三维刚体物体的动作条件化动力学，可在多物体场景中预测未来的刚体运动。
en_tdlr: Proposes MRO-GWM, a world model that learns action-conditional 3D dynamics of rigid objects using object-centric Gaussians and a novel temporal-spatial transformer architecture, enabling prediction of rigid body motion in multi-object scenes.
